RF1 constructs the relative quotient X_S = Y_S/φ^ℤ for every perfectoid S over 𝔽_q and every E, with wandering annuli, descent and compatibility of structure sheaves and valuations. RF1 compares with the fixed-field case only through the diamonds of FarguesFontaineDiamonds F1–F3; RF0:annuli compares only the chart rings.
overlaps.proposal: Keep both: Layer 6 is the absolute application of the foundations, and RF1 the general construction. Add to RF1 an adic-level comparison: for E = ℚ_p and S = Spa(F,𝒪_F), an isomorphism of adic spaces X_S ≅ 𝒳 extending RF0:annuli's ring identification and compatible with the Frobenius generator, the windows and the quotient maps. RF1's comparison with F1–F3 is then induced by this isomorphism rather than being a separate identification. Layer 6 should not be generalised to relative bases or other E.

overlaps.detail: For every perfect, complete, rank-one field F of characteristic p, Layer 6 (§6.1) forms A_inf = W(𝒪_F) with Witt Frobenius and Teichmüller lifts. It proves the (p,[ϖ])-adic topology complete and separated, and A_inf a complete Hausdorff Huber ring that is not Tate. AI.0 again forms A_inf = W(𝒪_{C♭}) with its Frobenius and proves the completeness, nonzerodivisor and torsion properties used later. For F = C♭ this is the same ring with the same topology, since the (p,μ)-adic and (p,[ϖ])-adic topologies coincide.
overlaps.proposal: AI.0 takes A_inf, its Frobenius and its (p,[ϖ])-adic completeness from Layer 6 with F = C♭, or both import one shared Witt-vector lemma, and proves its (p,μ)-adic and ξ-adic statements on that basis. AI.0 keeps θ and θ̃, μ, ξ and ξ̃, the residue map to W(k), the Breuil–Kisin twists and the comparison with A_cris. Layer 6 does not take on θ or period rings.

overlaps.detail: Layer 1 (§1.3) develops pro-constructible subsets of spectral spaces (closed in the patch topology), their calculus and the spectrality of pro-constructible subspaces, as a reusable topology package that Spa already needs. D0 lists constructible and pro-constructible subsets again among the extensions it makes to the spectral-space API.
overlaps.proposal: D0 imports Layer 1's pro-constructible sets, the patch topology and the spectrality theorem. It adds generalisation, spectral maps, limits of spectral spaces, the quotient criteria of ECD §2, profinite decompositions, extremally disconnected covers and the cardinal lemma. Layer 1 keeps its present scope.

overlaps.detail: Layer 3 constructs, for every Huber pair, the rational localisation (A_U, A_U⁺), presentation independence, restriction maps and the structure presheaves 𝒪_X and 𝒪_X⁺. For a discrete pair, A_U = A[1/s] with the discrete topology, and A_U⁺ is the integral closure of the image of A⁺[t/s]. SA.3 lists among its own targets the structure presheaves on discrete adic spectra (RC Definition 5.6.5, Proposition 5.6.6), while naming only AdicSpaces Layers 1–2 as inputs.
overlaps.proposal: SA.3 takes the ring and plus-ring presheaves from Layer 3 and proves the discrete-case identification A_U = R[1/s]. It keeps the analytic-ring structures (R,R⁺)_□, the idempotent-algebra property of rational localisations (Proposition 5.6.4), the descent theorem for D((𝒪_X(U),𝒪_X(U)⁺)_□) (Theorem 5.6.8) and the modified adic spectrum. Its inputs should add AdicSpaces Layer 3.
